import json
from decimal import Decimal

# Load orders
data = json.load(open("orders.json"), parse_float=Decimal)
orders = data["orders"]

# Count total orders
total_orders = len(orders)

# Count Royal Mail orders (preferred carrier)
royal_mail_orders = [o for o in orders if o["carrier"] == "Royal Mail"]
royal_mail_count = len(royal_mail_orders)

print(f"Total orders: {total_orders}")
print(f"Royal Mail orders: {royal_mail_count}")
